notes: Open in Claude now works with just the Claude app: the ✦ button installs Transmission as a Claude extension, with no command-line tools or Node to set up, and the audit playbooks (status, section review, consistency check) are in the chat's + menu. Transmission also moves to a current Electron, so the page preview renders modern sites properly and gets security fixes again, and links that open a new window go to your browser again.
